title: Mirrorball
description: A mirrorball in a dark room with one spotlight shining through a record sleeve. Every mirror carries a fragment of the cover, so Sgt. Pepper or Magical Mystery Tour scatters across the walls, floor and ceiling in its own colours. Throw it into a spin and the spots sweep round the corners of the room.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: each facet is a real mirror in a real-sized room, the spots are computed reflections of one lamp that slide continuously across every surface, and their colours come from the album you pick.
